skill.name: relight
skill.description: Relight still images with the RunComfy CLI. It helps change lighting direction, color temperature, intensity, and mood while preserving subject identity.
skill.summary: Change lighting on still images through RunComfy relighting and edit endpoints.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown formatting, documentation links, or placeholder URLs rather than executable shell interpolation. I confirmed the deliberate RunComfy CLI examples and scoped Bash usage as external command risk, and added a privacy finding for RunComfy API processing. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, arbitrary shell execution, or network reconnaissance.

remediation.suggestion: Keep the allowed Bash scope restricted to RunComfy commands and require user confirmation before uploads.
Tell users that image URLs and prompts are sent to RunComfy model services before running the skill.
Document token file permissions and recommend managed secrets for RUNCOMFY_TOKEN in CI environments.

content.value_statement: Image teams often need new lighting without a new shoot. This skill uses RunComfy relighting endpoints to adjust direction, color temperature, mood, and intensity.
actual_capabilities: Routes dedicated relighting requests to Qwen Edit 2509 Relight LoRA.
Uses alternate edit endpoints when lighting is part of a broader image edit.
Accepts user image URLs and lighting prompts through the RunComfy CLI.
Supports direction, color temperature, intensity, and mood instructions.
Writes generated image results to a selected output directory.
Provides prompt guidance for product, portrait, landscape, and batch workflows.
limitations: Works on still images, not video.
Requires the RunComfy CLI and an authenticated RunComfy account.
Uploads image URLs and prompts to RunComfy model services.
Results depend on source image quality, prompt clarity, and model availability.

use_cases.title: Catalog Photo Relighting
use_cases.description: A product marketer changes white-box product lighting into warm lifestyle lighting for a SKU gallery.

use_cases.title: Portrait Mood Changes
use_cases.description: A photographer shifts portraits from flat overcast light to golden-hour or studio lighting while preserving identity.

use_cases.title: Reference Lighting Match
use_cases.description: A designer applies the lighting direction and color tone from one reference image to another image.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Relight
prompt_templates.prompt: Relight this image with soft window light from the left. Preserve the subject, pose, framing, and colors.

prompt_templates.title: Product Lighting
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the relight skill on this product image. Apply warm 3200K studio light from camera-left with a soft shadow.

prompt_templates.title: Portrait Mood Shift
prompt_templates.prompt: Relight this portrait as golden hour. Add warm key light from front-left and subtle rim light behind the subject.

prompt_templates.title: Batch Lighting Match
prompt_templates.prompt: Relight these product images with the same lighting. Use neutral 5500K softbox light, consistent shadows, and preserved product color.

output_examples.input: User asks to relight a product photo with warm window light.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Qwen Edit Relight, prepares a RunComfy request, and returns the generated image location.

output_examples.input: User asks to match a portrait to a reference lighting photo.
output_examples.output: The skill chooses a reference-aware edit route and preserves the source subject while applying the target light style.

output_examples.input: User asks to relight several catalog images with identical shadows.
output_examples.output: The skill applies one lighting prompt across the image set and saves consistent results to the output folder.

best_practices: State the light source, direction, temperature, and intensity in the request.
Add preservation requirements for identity, framing, pose, and product color.
Use only image URLs the user supplied for the current task.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for text-to-image generation from scratch.
Do not submit private images without user approval for RunComfy processing.
Do not combine major object edits with strict relighting unless a broader edit endpoint is desired.

faq.question: Does this skill create images from scratch?
faq.answer: No. It edits existing still images and focuses on lighting changes.

faq.question: Does it work with video?
faq.answer: No. The documented CLI routes are for still images.

faq.question: Which model is the default?
faq.answer: It uses Qwen Edit 2509 Relight LoRA for dedicated relighting tasks.

faq.question: Can it preserve identity and product details?
faq.answer: It can request preservation, but results depend on the source image and model behavior.

faq.question: Does it send data outside my computer?
faq.answer: Yes. The RunComfy CLI posts image and prompt data to RunComfy model services.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI and sign in, or provide a RunComfy token in a managed environment.
